description: Calculate dipole synchrotron energy loss per turn, radiated power per beam and critical photon energy in an isomagnetic ring. Give total beam energy including rest energy, beam current and exactly one bending radius or dipole field; an optional circumference returns revolution frequency. Uses CODATA 2018 and classical radiation formulae; this is beam radiation rather than facility electrical demand.

energy_gev.description: Total energy in GeV, above rest energy.

field_t.description: Positive dipole field in tesla; supply this or radius_m.

radius_m.description: Positive bending radius in metres; supply this or field_t.

name: synchrotron_loss
title: Accelerator power and synchrotron loss
